title: Rocket Money Subscription Failure Rate
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rocketmoney:subscription
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(subscription_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by vendor_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Rocket Money subscription records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each vendor name.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize subscription_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per vendor name.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which parts of your Rocket Money subscription data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
